country_benchmark_source.methodology_section: About the Benefit expenditure by Country and Region tables
country_benchmark_source.scope: Combined State Pension expenditure for residents of each named country. The source separately lists overseas/unknown; no overseas share is allocated here. DWP estimates geographic expenditure from National Statistics caseload and average payments applied to total outturn.

unavailable.GB_by_type: Overseas expenditure/caseload are separated only for all State Pension types together.

unavailable.after_2030: No verified published long-term spending benchmark supplied.

coverage.geography_note: GB totals exclude overseas State Pension. Basic/new GB benchmarks remain unavailable because the workbook separates overseas only for their combined total.
